subject: Post-call recap: Acme Health private/VPC deployment requirements and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: Acme Health private/VPC deployment requirements and next steps

Hi Jordan — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have shared alignment and clear next steps. Please correct anything I missed.

Summary of goals/pain:
- Primary driver: PHI/data residency and internal policy requiring customer-controlled networking for inference (must remain within Acme Health VPCs or air-gapped environment).
- Security/compliance needs: SOC 2 evidence, KMS integration for keys, audit logs retention, and SCIM/SAML for SSO.
- Networking constraints: No outbound internet from inference subnets for the air-gapped workflow; requirement for VPC peering or PrivateLink-style connectivity for control-plane metadata only.
- Performance targets: 99th pct latency <250ms for chat flows and throughput ~200 concurrent sessions during business hours (ballpark from call).
- Operational requirements: model version pinning, ability to pin to a quantized variant, and offline model updates for air-gapped installs.

What Redwood can provide (high-level):
- Private deployment (VPC) with customer-managed networking and optional air-gap package for on-prem installs.
- KMS/HSM integration and audit logs export; configurable retention windows.
- Support for model pinning and canary rollouts within your private control plane.
- Technical SOW and runbook for network topology and maintenance procedures.

Attachments I shared on the call: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (SOC2 highlights), redwood-private-deploy-checklist.xlsx (network & infra checklist).

Agreed next steps (owners & timelines):
1) Jordan/Priya: share Acme network diagram and the internal security checklist (by EOD Thu 3/5) — this will let us confirm peering vs. air-gap requirements.
2) Vivek (SE): schedule a technical deep-dive to validate firewall rules, NAT/proxy needs, and expected VPC endpoints (target week of 3/9).
3) Monica (AE): draft a preliminary pricing & mutual action plan for Private deployment + estimated professional services for air-gap (by 3/6).
4) Marissa (me): send SOC 2 summary, high-level architecture options (peering vs. air-gap), and a sample mutual action plan (by 3/5).

Questions we still have:
- Do you anticipate any hardware-hardened HSM needs or is KMS integration sufficient?
- Any network egress restrictions that would block our control-plane heartbeat (we can design proxy/forwarder options if needed).

Thanks again — feel free to reply inline. I will follow up with the SOC2 summary and a proposed time for the technical call.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
